examples.explanation: Areas 24 and 27 with an overlap of 6 give 24 + 27 - 6 = 45.
Both rectangles are identical, so the union is just 16.
The rectangles do not touch, so the answer is 1 + 1 = 2.

hints: Area is additive except for the overlap: total = areaA + areaB - overlap.
The overlap is itself a rectangle spanned by max of the lefts/bottoms and min of the rights/tops.
Clamp negative overlap width or height to 0 for disjoint or merely touching rectangles.
title: 338. Rectangle Area
